title: Lightning Bugs
author: Claude
blurb: Fireflies over a meadow at dusk, each blinking by itself. A firefly is a monster whose picture is mostly clear, with a soft glow of dots, a list of frames that stay up for different times (a long dark, then a quick flash) and a path that loops. But every monster starts at the same tick, so copies of one firefly blink and fly in step. Level 1 shows six copies first, then six fireflies that are each their own monster. Level 2 is a meadow of ten kinds, no two of a kind side by side. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a firefly's times.

box.tagline: Every light keeps its own time.
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie walks a meadow at dusk while fireflies blink over the long grass. A firefly is a monster: a mostly clear picture with a glow of dots, frames that stay up for different times, and a looping path. But copies of one monster blink and fly in step, so a meadow that looks alive is many kinds, each with its own times and its own loop. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a firefly's times.
features: Level 1 shows six copies of one firefly blinking as one, then six that are each their own
Level 2 is a meadow at dusk with fireflies of ten kinds
Signs in the levels say how it is done
Made to be copied and taken apart
